name: morph
description: Using the morph Flutter package (Tembeon/morph): iOS 27 Liquid Glass controls that move as UIKit measures them - tab bar and lens, glass buttons and containers, menus and context menus, navigation stack and bars, sheets, alerts and action sheets, search, lists, segmented control, switch, slider, stepper, date picker - with the flat or liquid glass choice, setup, performance rules and migration from the old API.
